fullPassage: According to Einstein's theory, a large mass like the Sun 'bends' space-time. Newton's theory makes no such prediction. This bending of space-time leads to phenomena such as 'gravitational lensing' where the light of distant stars appears to be in different locations when they pass by a large mass like the Sun. We don't normally see this lensing because stars aren't visible during the day when the Sun is out, but a solar eclipse in 1919 allowed scientists to observe what the Sun's gravity was doing to the light from distant stars. The stars around the Sun appeared to have moved from their normal positions in the night sky. Despite the consistent efforts to confirm the precise orbit of planets within our solar system, observational schedules were often disrupted by local weather phenomena. The shift was much larger than Newton's theory predicted, but exactly in the positions predicted by Einstein's theory.

(A) The light of distant stars bends slightly as it passes close to a massive object like the Sun. Astronomers can measure this tiny change during an eclipse.

(B) The empty box was surprisingly light, so the child lifted it with one hand. She carried it upstairs without any help.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 light의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) light=빛(명사) / (B) light=가벼운(형용사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 빛 — (B) 가벼운: (A)는 별의 '빛'이 태양 옆에서 굴절되는 것, (B)는 빈 상자가 '가벼운' 것 ←정답
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜 — (A)가 빛, (B)가 가벼운
❌ ③ 등불/밝은은 각 문맥의 정확한 뜻이 아님
❌ ④ 신호/옅은은 각 문맥의 정확한 뜻이 아님
det.tip: light: 빛(the light of stars) / 가벼운(a light box)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a set of ideas or principles used to explain how or why something happens"

det.korean: 정의 = '어떤 일이 어떻게/왜 일어나는지 설명하는 아이디어·원리의 체계' → theory(이론)
det.analysis:
❌ ① method(방법) — 절차를 뜻하지 설명 체계가 아님
❌ ② myth(신화) — 근거 없는 이야기라 정의와 다름
❌ ③ fact(사실) — 이미 입증된 것이라 '설명하는 체계'와 다름
✅ ④ theory — '현상을 설명하는 원리·아이디어 체계'라는 정의에 정확히 부합. 지문의 Einstein's/Newton's theory와 같음 ←정답
det.tip: theory = 현상을 설명하는 이론 체계

questions.passage: According to Einstein's theory, a large mass like the Sun __________ (bend) space-time. Newton's theory makes no such prediction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: bend → bends: 주어가 a large mass(3인칭 단수)이고 현재시제라 동사에 -s를 붙임
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'a large mass like the Sun __________ space-time'으로, 주어 a large mass가 3인칭 단수예요. 현재시제 일반동사는 3인칭 단수 주어일 때 -s를 붙이므로 bend를 bends로 바꿔야 해요.
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 현재 → 동사 + s (a large mass bends)

questions.passage: Newton's theory makes no such prediction. This bending of space-time leads to phenomena such as 'gravitational lensing' where the light of __________ (distance) stars appears to be in different locations when they pass by a large mass like the Sun.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: distance → distant: 명사 distance(거리)를 뒤의 명사 stars를 꾸미는 형용사 distant(먼)로 바꿈
det.analysis: 빈칸은 '__________ (distance) stars'로, 뒤의 명사 stars를 앞에서 꾸미는 형용사 자리예요. 명사 distance(거리)를 형용사 distant(멀리 있는)로 바꿔야 '먼 별들'이라는 뜻이 돼요.
det.tip: distance(명사, 거리) → distant(형용사, 먼)

questions.passage: According to Einstein's theory, a large mass like the Sun 'bends' space-time. Newton's theory makes no such prediction. This bending of space-time leads to phenomena such as 'gravitational lensing' where the light of distant stars appears to be in __________ when they pass by a large mass like the Sun. We don't normally see this lensing because stars aren't visible during the day when the Sun is out, but a solar eclipse in 1919 allowed scientists to observe what the Sun's gravity was doing to the light from distant stars. The stars around the Sun appeared to have moved from their normal positions in the night sky. Despite the consistent efforts to confirm the precise orbit of planets within our solar system, observational schedules were often disrupted by local weather phenomena. The shift was much larger than Newton's theory predicted, but exactly in the positions predicted by Einstein's theory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: different locations — 별빛이 중력에 의해 굴절되어 '다른 위치(different locations)'에 나타남
det.analysis:
❌ ① brighter colors(더 밝은 색) — 빛의 위치 변화 이야기라 색과 무관
✅ ② different locations — 원문 일치. 별빛이 굴절되어 '다른 위치'에 나타남 ←정답
❌ ③ equal distances(같은 거리) — 위치가 달라진다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ④ faster speeds(더 빠른 속도) — 속도가 아니라 위치의 문제
det.tip: appears to be in different locations — 다른 위치에 나타남

questions.passage: According to Einstein's theory, a large mass like the Sun 'bends' space-time. Newton's theory makes no such prediction. This bending of space-time leads to phenomena such as 'gravitational lensing' where the light of distant stars appears to be in different locations when they pass by a large mass like the Sun. We don't normally see this lensing because stars aren't visible during the day when the Sun is out, but a solar eclipse in 1919 allowed scientists to observe what the Sun's gravity was doing to the light from distant stars. The stars around the Sun appeared to have moved from their normal positions in the night sky. Despite the consistent efforts to confirm the precise orbit of planets within our solar system, observational schedules were often disrupted by local weather phenomena. The shift was __________ than Newton's theory predicted, but exactly in the positions predicted by Einstein's theory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: much larger — 관측된 이동이 뉴턴 예측보다 '훨씬 더 컸다(much larger)'
det.analysis:
❌ ① slightly smaller(약간 더 작은) — 이동이 예측보다 컸다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ② nearly equal(거의 같은) — 뉴턴 예측과 차이가 컸으므로 부적절
✅ ③ much larger — 원문 일치. 이동이 뉴턴 예측보다 '훨씬 더 컸고' 아인슈타인 예측과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ completely absent(완전히 없는) — 이동이 실제로 관측되었으므로 모순
det.tip: The shift was much larger than Newton's theory predicted — 훨씬 더 큰
